description: Three-phase energy meter with RS-485, Ethernet, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth: voltages, currents, frequency, power, power factor, energy, demand, THD, minimums and maximums, mass memory settings and commands
notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485 and Modbus TCP (port 502, up to 2 sockets). Addresses are numbered from 1 as in the document (30.015 is input register 15, sent as 14). Commands are coils: command 006 is coil 6, sent as 5.

Float values use the KRON sequence F2, F1, F0, EXP, which is the bytes fully reversed (the document's example sends 60 Hz as 00 00 70 42): little byte order and little word order. That is the default of holding register 42901; changing it breaks the float registers. Integers described as MSB first override this with big byte order.

The document gives 254 as the factory Modbus RTU address and 255 as the Modbus TCP slave id; 255 is used here. After a factory restore (coil 090) the serial format is 8N2 at 9600 bit/s, which is what the connection defaults show. Baud rates 9600, 19200, 38400 and 57600; formats 8N1, 8N2, 8E1 and 8O1. At most 8 holding registers per request.

Registers marked firmware 6.7 or later exist only from that version; the document does not say how older units answer. Holding register 40007 and most network settings take effect only after the device restarts (coil 006).

The THD values have no scale or unit in the document and are given raw. The harmonic grouping tables (34.001 to 34.480), the real-time clock registers 42.001 to 42.004 (packed BCD), the MAC addresses (6 raw bytes at 39.501 to 39.509), the IP, mask, gateway and DNS addresses, the MQTT broker, user, token and topic strings, the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth passwords, the LoRa keys and settings, the solar module registers (special version) and the mass memory read-out are not mapped.
Written from the protocol document; this map has not been tested on a device.

registers.name: Error code (hardware)
registers.description: Bit field. Low byte: 1 phase reversal or loss, 2 math error, 8 Urms or Irms limit exceeded, 16 incorrect restart, 64 RTC battery low, 128 mass memory error. High byte: 1 synchronising phases, 2 frequency out of range, 8 firmware protection active, 32 Wi-Fi or Bluetooth module error, 64 Ethernet module error

registers.name: Error code (Wi-Fi module)
registers.description: Bit field, low byte: 1 connection time-out, 2 wrong password, 4 access point not found, 8 connection failed, 16 broker refused login, 32 publish error, 64 no internet, 128 unknown error. High byte reserved
